prompt:
Subject:
Offering a shell at the shoreline

Main Subject:
A knee-up portrait of a young woman wearing a white ruffled bikini with a blue small floral pattern kneeling on the sand at the edge of a transparent sea, holding out a palm with a conch shell toward the camera. The hand and conch shell in the left foreground are very large, showing the face in the center and the sea and reefs in the background.

Person/Expression:
Rounded oval face with a small chin, face tilted slightly to the left. Large light gray-brown almond eyes, thin relaxed eyebrows, slender nose bridge and small tip, gentle smile with glossy pale pink lips closed. Bright skin with pink cheeks and subtle makeup. Dark brown long hair in a half-up style with braids, thin bangs and wet hair strands flowing to the cheeks and chest, with a large white flower pinned to her own left ear side.

Clothing/Pose:
A triangle bikini swimsuit with small pale blue flowers scattered on a white background. Thin neck strap, waving white ruffles on the chest, a long bow in the center, and thin ties on both hips. Sitting with both knees open on the sand, extending her own right arm straight to the left front of the screen. Palm open upward, carrying a small conch shell with peach-white spots. Left hand on the sand at the bottom right to support the body.

Background/Light:
Foreground is bright sand including white shell fragments. Transparent turquoise shallow sea and small waves from left to center, gray reef and greenery on the right back. Upper part is a vivid blue sky and white cumulus clouds. Hard direct sunlight from the upper left brightly illuminates the face, shoulders, chest, thighs, and palm.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical. Camera at the same horizontal eye level as the kneeling person, a knee-up image capturing from the sky above the head to mid-knee. The extended hand is included as a large foreground of screen width from bottom left to center, with the shell and fingers softly blurred by distance. Place the face in the center of the upper third, focusing sharply on the eyes.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo based on white, pale blue, turquoise, and pink. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, floral patterns and ruffles, wet hair, shell spots, sand grains, and transparent waves.

Negative:
Do not make the foreground hand and shell small; do not remove the shell from the palm.
